issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE 'python:3.12' duplicated across backend constant, TS fallback, and TS exported const
issues.detail: The literal lives in pipeline.py, Commands.ts fallback, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx, defeating the purpose of the new RPC. When the default changes, sites drift silently. Backend must own the constant; frontend reads it via RPC with no literal fallbacks elsewhere.

issues.description: Semantic change: empty base_image now coerced to python:3.12 instead of falling through to kfp default
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' allowed the Jinja 'or' chain and kfp defaulting to take over; now _set_base_image forces DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE. The adjacent comment still says 'Use kfp default image' — it is now a lie. This collapses 'unset' and 'default' into one state and changes runtime behavior on an exception path.

issues.description: Reset-to-default and inheritance precedence collapse 'unset' vs 'explicitly default'
issues.detail: updateBaseImage('') is used both to clear and to mean 'use default', and the resolution rule (cell > pipeline > global default) is reimplemented in the Jinja template, dialog placeholder, and createBaseImageText. Users can no longer express 'inherit from pipeline'. Extract one resolveBaseImage function and preserve the empty sentinel.

issues.description: Inline Input replaced by Button+Dialog is a UX regression with more machinery for the same single string
issues.detail: The previous inline Input let users see and edit the base image directly. The new flow adds modal state, a disabled-until-step-name button with no explanation, and extra clicks. Showing the default could have been a placeholder or helper text on the original Input without the Dialog imports and toggle plumbing.

issues.description: Function-scope import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside RPC with no circular-import justification
issues.detail: get_default_base_image does 'from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' inside the function body. There is no cycle to break — the rest of the module imports from kale freely. Move to module top, or add a one-line comment naming the cycle. As written it is cargo-culted defensive code.

issues.description: No tests for the new RPC, changed fallback semantics, or React plumbing
issues.detail: A new RPC endpoint, an exception-path semantic change in pipeline.py, a new template variable, and prop-drilled state all land with zero tests. The pipeline.py change in particular silently alters runtime behavior. Add a test that fails without the patch and passes with it, especially for the empty-string fallback.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on REFUSE / NEEDS-SPLIT. A small UI feature smuggles in a backend semantic change (empty base_image fallback now hardcodes python:3.12 instead of deferring to kfp), and the new RPC's whole purpose — single source of truth for the default — is defeated by duplicating 'python:3.12' across at least three sites. The Input-to-Dialog rewrite is easy-not-simple and a UX regression for editing a single string. No tests accompany the change. Fixes: split into three patches, one canonical backend constant fetched once, preserve the empty sentinel and extract one resolveBaseImage rule, hoist the function-scope import, and add a regression test for the fallback path.
